_about: Forge services (Godot build: game/systems/forge.gd), at any npc with `forge: true` (a smith in any major town). Raising gear's item level is no longer smith's work: enchanters do it (enchanting.json). `scrap` destroys an item for `baseBars` bars of its band (by rarity; cloth and leather give none; `bars`: the first band whose `upToLevel` is at least the item's level) and its gems back, but not its enchantment (disenchant it instead); the window shows what you get first. `reforge` swaps one of an item's stats for another, from `options` choices shown up front, for coins (one reforge an item; doing it again replaces it). `sockets`: a socket takes `share` of the item's stat budget, which a gem of its quality fills back (gems.json); a forge can punch one more (`punch`) into enhanced gear or better, to `max` sockets.
